title: cakeFilter operation
description: A cake filter on a slurry, constant pressure, two-resistance law (Geankoplis, Hersel & Lepek 5th ed. section 24.2): t/V = K_p V/2 + B with K_p = mu alpha c_S/(A^2 dp), B = mu R_m/(A dp); a compressible cake alpha = alpha0 dp^s. Model rotaryDrum is continuous (declare cycleTime or area, the other is the result; eq. 24.2-26); batchPress is cyclic (declare area, filtratePerCycle and cleaningTime; the cycle time and the number of presses are results). The streams are cycle-averaged flows. Inlets (slurry [wash]), outlets (cake filtrate [spentWash]). The liquid viscosity is the package's and its model must be declared by the case.

pressureDrop.title: Pressure drop across cake and medium

specificCakeResistance.title: Specific cake resistance alpha (incompressible cake)
specificCakeResistance.description: Use this OR alpha0 with compressibility, never both.

alpha0.title: alpha0 of alpha = alpha0 dp^s
alpha0.description: Read in SI (m/kg with dp in Pa); its dimensions have no integer form. Give with compressibility.

compressibility.title: Compressibility s
compressibility.description: The exponent s of alpha = alpha0 dp^s (Geankoplis eq. 24.2-11). Give with alpha0.

wetToDryCakeRatio.title: Wet-to-dry cake ratio m
wetToDryCakeRatio.description: kg wet cake per kg dry cake: the cake moisture, declared (Geankoplis eq. 24.2-10).

submergence.title: Submergence f (rotaryDrum)
submergence.description: The fraction of each revolution in which cake forms.

cycleTime.title: Cycle time t_c (rotaryDrum)
cycleTime.description: Declare this XOR area; the other is the result.

area.title: Filter area A
area.description: batchPress: declared. rotaryDrum: declare this XOR cycleTime.

washFlowPath.title: Wash flow path (batchPress with a wash)
washFlowPath.description: sameAsFiltrate: wash at the final filtration rate (eq. 24.2-19, leaf filter). throughWashing: one quarter of it (eq. 24.2-20, plate-and-frame).

washing.title: Washing law
washing.description: Required when a wash inlet is connected, and only then. The solute left in the cake after a wash ratio N (wash volume / liquor in the cake).

model.title: Washing law
model.description: displacement: R = max(0, 1 - N), ideal displacement. tabulated: the case's own wash test, ln R linear in N between the points, no extrapolation.

remaining.title: Solute remaining R (tabulated)
remaining.description: One value per wash ratio, non-increasing, each in (0, 1].
